invariants: copy cannot claim capabilities beyond admitted evidence
benchmark claims require named method scope date and source
candidate prices cannot be represented as validated market prices
public CTA cannot activate unavailable product capability
primary navigation must remain usable without pointer input
every interactive control requires accessible name and focus state
essential product use cannot require marketing consent
analytics must not collect raw research content or tenant-private data
consent rejection must be as easy as consent acceptance
experiments cannot change security rights billing or evidence authority
client copy cannot choose tenant entitlement or commercial authority
pricing display must resolve from server-side versioned price book
marketing attribution cannot override source provenance
testimonials require verified permission and factual attribution
scarcity urgency and social proof cannot be fabricated
SEO pages cannot be generated without unique useful reviewed content
canonical URLs and locale alternates must be deterministic
landing claims must expose limitations where omission would mislead
error states must preserve user work or explain recoverability
destructive actions require explicit confirmation and reversible path when possible
product UX must distinguish proposal evidence and admitted conclusion
AI-generated copy requires human editorial approval before publication
paid media requires bounded budget and measured return gate
campaign scaling requires validated conversion and contribution margin
public publication requires product security legal privacy and brand approvals
production traffic remains independent from engineering evidence
Stripe live remains independent from public landing publication
marketing opt-out must propagate across supported channels
events require versioned names and documented purpose
sensitive identifiers must be pseudonymised or excluded
dark patterns are prohibited
accessibility defects of critical severity block release
mobile core journey must not lose functional capability
performance budgets are release gates for landing and authenticated shell
copy changes require locale consistency review
experiment allocation must be deterministic and auditable
experiment stopping rules must be declared before exposure
negative experiment outcomes must be retained
marketing spend cannot be increased by a model or worker
campaign claims cannot use sandbox payment evidence as customer proof
public roadmap statements require explicit status labels
contact forms require purpose limitation retention and abuse controls
legal links must remain available before conversion
cookie wall cannot block strictly necessary functionality
publication rollback must restore prior approved copy and metadata
models cannot publish externally
CI cannot grant brand legal privacy or commercial approval
all public surfaces must identify AXIGNAL consistently
final UX acceptance requires representative human usability evidence
